cell.description: The default AFS cell this client belongs to. Used when no explicit cell is specified in paths.

cellinfo.description: Additional AFS cells to recognize, with their authentication URLs.

url.description: Authentication service URL for the cell (e.g., 'http://afs.example.com/auth')

cache_dir.description: Directory where the AFS client stores cached files and metadata.

cache_size.description: Size of the AFS cache in kilobytes (KB). Adjust based on available disk space and workload.

local_auth.description: Whether to enable local authentication (fallback when Kerberos is unavailable). Disable in production if using Kerberos.

kernel_module.description: Whether to load the AFS kernel module for improved performance and integration.

cache_cleaner_threads.description: Number of threads used for cleaning stale cache entries.

bkg_io_threads.description: Maximum number of threads for background I/O (e.g., cache writes, prefetching).

bind_interfaces.description: List of network interface names to bind to (e.g., ['eth0', 'bond0']). Leave empty to use all interfaces.

auth_timeout.description: Authentication timeout in seconds for network-based authentication services.

verbose.description: Enable verbose/debug logging to help troubleshoot issues.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging (e.g., 'daemon', 'local0', 'user').

cell_server_list.description: Path to the per-cell server list file. Usually managed automatically; override only for custom setups.

cell_servdb.description: Path to the CellServDB file containing server addresses for all known cells.
